## Description
Briefly describe the change, its rationale, and which studio or engine component it affects.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance optimization (CST parser, virtual window, hashing)
- [ ] UI / UX enhancement (theme, layout, icons)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Testing & CI improvement

## Affected Studio / Subsystem
- [ ] 2-Way Text / AST Code Diff
- [ ] 3-Way Merge Studio
- [ ] Folder & Archive Sync Hub
- [ ] Visual Media & PDF Diff
- [ ] Tabular / Excel / Parquet Diff
- [ ] Hex / Binary Diff
- [ ] Structured Tree Diff (JSON/YAML/XML)
- [ ] Windows Shell Integration & Installer

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Ran `python -m unittest discover tests` with all tests passing
- [ ] Added unit tests for new functionality / bug fixes
- [ ] Verified on high-DPI / dark & light theme modes
- [ ] Ensured no hardcoded paths or credentials were committed
